# PolyBench/GPU (sgrauerg/polybenchGpu 5584aaa), MINI_DATASET, built for sm_86 with CUDA 13.0.
# Each compares its GPU result with its own CPU reference and prints how many outputs

# 10-minute limit on the runner's 4 CPUs.
